flora: Thick mats of Liverworts covering a fallen log
Rising steam from a nearby volcanic spring
Tiny Equisetites (Horsetail) shoots poking through the mat
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; creating a 'micro-landscape' feel; very wet and lush atmosphere.

visual_logic.composition: A close-to-the-ground view of a decaying log by a misty lake. The log is completely smothered in a slick, bright green carpet of liverworts. Tiny 'umbrellas' sprout everywhere. The air is thick with mist.
visual_logic.ground: Black volcanic mud and wet, rotting wood.
visual_logic.lighting: Flat, diffused morning light filtered through heavy mist and steam.
